focus: This week: we brought the public changelog fully up to date — the 'what we've shipped' page now reflects everything that's gone live since April, including the Oracle AI answer engine, web push notifications, the move to faster global hosting, the find-your-game quiz, and the theme system. We also made the changelog self-maintaining, so it can never quietly fall months behind again.
